title: At Gloria Steinem Memorial, Michelle Obama, Hillary Clinton and More Big Names Gather
summary: Former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton and other luminaries spoke at the event, which also featured performances by Cynthia Erivo and Kathy Sledge.
